record_title: Generalized packing-covering conjecture through redundancy fifteen
provenance: A refinement of the redundancy-fourteen theorem of Essayag and Zabokritskiy, arXiv:2609.19098, resolving its explicit first remaining binary parameter tuple by a finite-geometric line-multiplicity bound after dual shortening.
limitations: The theorem stops at redundancy fifteen. The same reductions leave several parameter families at redundancy sixteen, and the present line-cap estimate does not eliminate them. No optimality is claimed for the intermediate bound k <= 62. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.19098 is very recent and explicitly identifies the resolved tuple as the next remaining case.
